title: Registration versus a metadata document
lede: With dynamic client registration the client registers first and gets an id. With CIMD the id is a URL and the server reads the document behind it.

nodes.label: Client
sub: Wants to ask for a code

nodes.label: Client database
sub: Issues an id (and maybe a secret)

steps.title: DCR: register first
steps.what: The client posts its metadata, the server stores it and returns an id. The server now owns a record per client.

steps.title: Then authorize
steps.what: The request carries the issued client_id.

steps.title: CIMD: no registration
steps.what: The client_id is a URL. The server fetches the document at request time and validates it. The client owns the document, the server keeps no record.
